audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit DMCircuit performs state preparation, RXX gates, custom Kraus-channel application, and observable evaluation. JAX supplies differentiation and array operations; Optax supplies Adam. No other quantum framework is imported.
audit.cheating_rationale: The true probabilities are used only to generate the authorized synthetic target table. Fitted parameters are independently initialized and optimized. No hidden answers, evaluator manipulation, or hardcoded fitted outputs appear.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation constructs all four specified probes, applies the even and odd noisy entangler layers, and measures every single-site Z and full-chain parity. It uses the specified Kraus operators, sigmoid parameterization, mean squared error, and exactly config['max_steps'] Adam updates at the configured learning rate. Losses are recorded before each update, and final expectations are evaluated at the final fitted probabilities. All required outputs are NumPy arrays.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error is present. Channel transition directions, probe preparations, circuit ordering, optimization bookkeeping, and output shapes match the specification.
